summary: Phase 3 is accepted after independent verification and one acceptance-role fix to the composer save payload. Tasks 3.1-3.3 are complete with commit evidence, 3.4 is structurally blocked as deferred:user, FR1/FR2/FR3/FR5 and AC2 are covered by live render/interaction tests, the teacher route is server-gated, and all requested acceptance gates exit 0.
nonblocking_findings: Acceptance found and fixed a Phase 3 composer gap before verdict: LessonComposer.saveTeacherDraft previously sent only lesson title plus phase title/type, dropping authored sections, activities, activity props, markdown, and callouts at the Phase 2 client boundary. LessonComposer now sends the full sanitized lesson tree, and LessonComposer.test.tsx asserts the full sanitized payload.

measure/tracks.md still labels Teacher Content Authoring as PLANNED. This is conservative and not an A6 overstatement, but it understates that Phase 3 has now passed acceptance while later phases remain open.

PhaseRenderer/SectionBlock student lesson path still does not forward extra authored content props to ActivityRenderer outside the new authored-preview path; Review C also recorded this as pre-existing architecture limitation, not a Phase 3 blocker.
Generated route facts now include GET /teacher/content-authoring in measure/generated/routes.md, removing stale-route drift for the Phase 3 route.
evidence: Plan markers verified in measure/tracks/teacher-content-authoring_20260605/plan.md: Phase 3 tasks 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3 are [x] with commit 4e43965b evidence; task 3.4 is [b] with deferred:user; the Phase 3 block has no bare [ ] tasks.

FR1 verified from composer-state.ts and LessonComposer.tsx plus tests: state supports phases, sections, activities, add/remove/reorder operations, accessible React controls, and save now forwards the full sanitized lesson tree to the Phase 2 client adapter.

FR2 verified from composer-state.ts and activity-config-validation.ts: deriveActivityFormFields uses live SCHEMA_REGISTRY/getPropsSchema, validation uses validateActivityConfig, unknown placeholder keys fail closed, invalid configs block save/preview, and tests assert field/path errors with real schemas.

FR3/AC2 verified after Review C fix and acceptance rerun: ActivityRenderer accepts activityProps and spreads them into registered activity components; AuthoredLessonPreview passes authored activity.props into ActivityRenderer; AuthoredLessonPreview.test.tsx asserts the authored equation x^2 + 3x - 4 reaches the registered activity component, not just a shell.

FR5 status surfacing verified from get-teacher-authoring-status-view.ts and LessonComposer.tsx: teacherFacingStatus, rejectionComment, submitted/approved/published disabled/edit states, and edit-after-reject action are rendered and covered by status-view and LessonComposer tests.

Route gate verified from app/teacher/content-authoring/page.tsx and page.test.tsx: the async server component calls requireTeacherSessionClaims('/auth/login') before rendering, and the test proves auth redirect propagation for unauthenticated/non-teacher callers.

A1 verified in measure/automation-supervisor.py: task parsing uses r'^- \[([~xb])\] (.+)' and is_task_structurally_blocked recognizes status 'b' and trailing deferred:<owner> without substring-matching free-text deferred.

A3/A4/A7 checked: Phase 3 tests use direct lengths and DOM assertions, not digit-only rg count assertions; render/interaction tests exercise non-empty fixtures and activity prop forwarding; no over-broad banned-term filter is part of the Phase 3 proof.

A5 checked: plan.md Phase 3 closeout cites npx tsc --noEmit from repo root as exit 0; the app-level tsc exit 2 appears only in Red evidence and is not claimed as a Green closeout pass. No PASS=N FAIL=0 or all checks pass overclaim was found in the Phase 3 plan evidence.
A6 checked: measure/tracks.md marks Teacher Content Authoring as [ ] PLANNED, so it does not overstate the track as shipped/resolved while later phases remain open.
No _add_types.* files were found; git status before result writing contained only the acceptance-role product/test fix plus the new result JSON.
